study.question: Can modest layer-specific shared scorer reductions preserve the strongest current click AUC while reducing measured prediction cost? Local observations: original coupled64/32 to32/16 reduced AUC0.666753547526167 to0.6654368615912554 (loss0.0013166859349126), confounded by changed initialization draws. Current global-summary parent AUC0.6675018907227037 has31993779 parameters. Latest weighted reference/quadratic/cubic/both all give that same AUC; inference seconds28.5538/28.8936/29.1799/30.0246 and p50ms14.7953/14.9931/15.1550/15.4006 provide no cost support for those shortcuts. Review covers positive global-summary trajectory and failed halving/weighted branches; no new outcome is asserted.
study.hypothesis: A small amount of nonlinear scorer capacity may be dispensable despite older aggressive halving failure. Late-constructor reductions64 to56 and32 to24 can reduce per-slot affine/Dice work while preserving enough target-history scoring information. Individual layer effects and interaction are unresolved. Common fresh template controls all other initial weights/RNG. Inherited scale, prefix choice and optimization changes remain alternative explanations. This is a bounded local utility hypothesis; no new architecture or verified novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines56-120 inspected. Retain target-conditioned local activation and Dice; test local layer-capacity allocation in the existing four-task compressed-history model, not a new attention principle or exact DIN reproduction.

Authorized source matches parent SHA256. All representations, routes, gradient ownership, owner rank96 and prediction optimizations are inherited. Only effective scorer widths after complete initialization change.

Unsuccessful aggressive coupled reduction at older allocation changed initialization draws. New modest layer-specific2x2 contrast uses a contemporaneous control and identical fresh template; the earlier receipt is not reclassified as a capacity-only causal result.

inherited_components: Full100-event information/masks, all original field embeddings, five summaries and support gates, uniform/feedback compression.
Shared action-aware DIN local scorer and Dice, four task heads/residuals, sum-four-BCE and ownership stops.
Current head budgets, semantic owner partition/native rank96 context factor, global-summary evaluation, merged_hoist affine and evaluation Dice.
Original initialization order/RNG and prefix-cloning helper; no checkpoint pruning, distillation, external data or new labels.
study.proposed_difference: Add architecture-only scorer_hidden_units, hold attention_hidden_units=[64,32] as initialization template, validate effective widths and apply existing Linear/Dice prefix-cloning helper to local_activation after all original construction/reset/reductions/SVD, before host optimizer creation. Compare56/32,64/24,56/24 with unchanged64/32. Remove discarded Parameter and Dice-buffer storage. No forward, mask, summary, route, gate, evaluation or loss method changes. No industry architecture component adopted.
predictions: Frozen before screening: preservation requires full-validation click AUC within0.00010 below contemporaneous64/32 reference AND frozen current0.6675018907227037 (absolute floor0.6674018907227037). Also report original joint0.666753547526167 and DIN0.6555440824200336; older references cannot substitute for current preservation. Single-seed outcomes stay preliminary.

Utility additionally requires actual parameter reduction, at least3% lower model-only whole-batch p50 AND3% lower complete validation inference seconds than contemporary control, with p95 no more than2% worse under matched precision/batch/loading/device/timing. Confirm with reserved matched authorized repetitions; if repetition/timing interfaces are unavailable, label utility unconfirmed. Report training and memory even when worse.

Expected reference/first56/second24/both totals31993779/31990307/31993243/31989835. Embeddings31793216 unchanged; scorer-only parameters27873/24401/27337/23929 including Dice alpha but excluding running buffers. Reduced storage/MACs alone is not speed evidence.

First-layer compute reduction exceeds second-only reduction; shape utilization can reverse measured latency. Report factorial interaction in AUC and costs, all four AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean and existing history slices. Current parent already sacrifices auxiliary quality relative to DIN; click utility does not establish joint-task dominance.
falsifiers: Control AUC mismatch beyond1e-6, wrong initial nonscorer state/RNG, masking/ownership failure or unexpected counts invalidates interpretation; preserve failure costs and diagnose.
Reproducible AUC loss beyond0.00010 or failure of declared measured-cost thresholds rejects that concrete reduction even if parameter/MAC counts fall.

Failure of all three bounded reductions limits this implementation hypothesis without proving all scorer capacity necessary. Combined-only success requires interaction attribution, not either single-layer explanation.
alternative_explanations: Retained prefix weights inherit template Xavier scale; width-specific variance and channel selection are unresolved alternatives to capacity effects.
Earlier scorer halving predates current allocation and changed initialization draws; its failure is not a matched current capacity contrast.
Changed scorer alters upstream representations and shared dense clipping; identical nonscorer initialization does not imply equal later updates.
Single-seed selection, repeated-user dependence, BF16 rounding/GEMM shapes, hardware utilization and runtime noise; fewer MACs do not establish measured speed.
